meta_data.base_class: analyze the overall sentiment on a specific <social media platform> toward a certain topic - different platforms have distinct content ecosystems but share the same analysis structure.

tool_template.name: sentiment_analysis.<class>
tool_template.description: Analyzes the overall sentiment of <class> towards a certain topic.

topic.description: The topic you want to analyze the sentiment for on <class>.

language.description: The language of the content to analyze on <class>.

num_content.description: Number of pieces of content to analyze on <class>.

filter_date_range.description: An array containing two dates (start and end) to filter the <class> content for sentiment analysis. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

region.description: Restrict the sentiment analysis on <class> to content originating from a specific region or country.

include_video.description: If true, include video content in the give topic sentiment analysis on <class>, which may increase processing time.

include_extreme_sentiments.description: If true, highlights the most positive and most negative examples of content from <class> within the analysis range.
